subject.title: fix(ui): localize settings navigation and Logs copy

question: Should this maintainer-owned UI localization change land now with the serialized generated-locale refresh following it, or should the refresh be required in the same reviewed sequence?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes runtime lookup keys before generated locale bundles are refreshed, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit owner judgment on that release sequencing.

options.title: Approve the serialized refresh sequence
options.body: Land this focused key migration and ensure the established post-merge locale refresh is queued immediately afterward.

options.title: Require refresh evidence first
options.body: Hold merge until the generated locale-refresh result or equivalent proof confirms the new keys resolve for supported non-English locales.

recommendation.title: Approve the serialized refresh sequence
recommendation.body: Land this focused key migration and ensure the established post-merge locale refresh is queued immediately afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current maintainer-authored branch and its stated locale-refresh sequencing.
